races.display_title: Buckley Agri New Holland Irish EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Only a handful are of any real interest, with LENNON GROVE 's second in a Grade 2 mares bumper at Aintree in the spring catching the eye and she's taken to make a winning start over hurdles. The Besty Woman seems to be getting better with racing and is entitled to be in the mix, with Al Arrivee another threat providing this doesn't turn into a speed test. LENNON GROVE (IRE) THE BESTY WOMAN (IRE) AL ARRIVEE (FR)

races.display_title: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: GIVE IT A CRACK was placed on both starts in points, is in excellent hands and looks to have been found a winnable opportunity on hurdles debut. Course bumper winner Tell The Boys was well fancied when failing to complete on hurdling debut and may prove the main threat, while Coolishael and Rokanako bring the best previous form and are also capable of being involved. races.verdict: KILBRIN ROCCO returns to hurdling from a potentially lenient mark on recent chase form and is fancied to give the McCarthy yard a second successive win in this race. Jaadil hasn’t fired this season and is ideally suited by further, but a switch to a yard with a strong record at this meeting could spark a revival. Churchwarden returns to hurdles in good heart and is also respected. KILBRIN ROCCO (IRE) JAADIL (IRE) CHURCHWARDEN (IRE)

races.verdict: MART LANE is progressing in handicaps and went close at Galway 17 days ago despite a mistake 2 out, so is taken to go one better. Boston Rajj should strip fitter for the recent run and looks well treated on debut for new connections, while First Ascent is open to improvement and rates best of the rest. Killowen House can also be involved if handling this sharp track. MART LANE (IRE) BOSTON RAJJ (IRE) FIRST ASCENT (IRE) KILLOWEN HOUSE (IRE)

races.display_title: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A cracking beginners chase. The vote goes to LOVE ME TENDER , who finished with running left when fourth on his chasing debut at the Galway Festival and the youngest of Willie Mullins' quartet seems sure to improve for that initial experience. Fort Dino left his chasing debut form well behind when runner-up at Killarney 5 weeks ago so heads up the threats, with I Will Be Baie and Largy Hill both adding another layer of intrigue returning from significant absences. LOVE ME TENDER (FR) FORT DINO (FR) I WILL BE BAIE (FR)
races.betting_forecast: I Will Be Baie (7/2), Love Me Tender (9/2), Jarrive De Mee (5/1), Largy Hill (5/1), Tackletommywoowoo (6/1), Will Do (7/1), Chanceawetmorning (8/1), Fort Dino (8/1), Our Soldier (14/1), Rattledelatch (25/1), Ellens Pride (150/1), Three County Star (200/1), Barton Sky (250/1)

races.display_title: Kevin McManus Bookmaker Flat Race
races.verdict: SIERRASCOPE showed plenty when fourth of 19 in a valuable sales bumper at the Punchestown Festival in the spring and is taken to confirm that promise by opening his Rules account at the second time of asking. Berkstar has an ordinary pedigree but must be feared having joined Willie Mullins after finishing runner-up on his sole outing in points earlier in the year. Veales Cross would also enter calculations if the subject of support. SIERRASCOPE BERKSTAR (IRE) VEALES CROSS (IRE)

races.display_title: Weekend Winners On At The Races Handicap
races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but the vote goes to RENEWABLE DREAM who took a step forward for his new handler when running on into third at Wolverhampton (form been well advertised since) and can gain a first win now returned to 1m here. Ocean Force rates a big danger if, as expected, proving better suited to this track than when sixth at Lingfield last time. C&D scorer Starakova and handicap debutante Roccapina are other likely players too in this competitive handicap. RENEWABLE DREAM OCEAN FORCE (IRE) STARAKOVA
races.betting_forecast: Starakova (7/2), King Sharja (4/1), Hear The Drums (7/1), Renewable Dream (7/1), Mercurius Power (8/1), Ocean Force (8/1), Roccapina (10/1), Potters Prince (12/1), Al Suil Eile (20/1), Soames Forsyte (20/1), Cy Twombly (25/1), Danrana (25/1), Arc La Shari (33/1), Southern Warrior (50/1)

races.display_title: Follow AtTheRaces On X Nursery
races.verdict: This is wide open. EEVEE STAR showed the benefit of blinkers when a resurgent fourth at Newcastle last time and eased 1 lb here, she can gain a breakthrough victory with the step up to 7f and the services of Billy Loughnane both likely positives. Richard Hannon's From Me To You advanced his form when third at Wolverhampton and heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Claret And Blues and No More Pino can play a prominent role too. EEVEE STAR FROM ME TO YOU (IRE) CLARET AND BLUES

races.display_title: Equine Products UK Best Turned Out Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ANOTHER HIGH FIVE progressed nicely over hurdles last season and is expected to make up into a better chaser, so he's a fascinating contender on reappearance with 3m also in his favour. Upfordebate and Sean Og finished first and second in this race a year ago and are respected, while Juke Hill isn't passed over lightly for this jockey/trainer combination. ANOTHER HIGH FIVE (IRE) UPFORDEBATE (IRE) SEAN OG (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Sir Carnegie (10/3), Another High Five (4/1), Inis Oirr (9/2), Sean Og (5/1), Juke Hill (7/1), Wasdell Dundalk (10/1), Upfordebate (10/1), Judicial Review (14/1), Midnight Moonshine (25/1)
